headline: JBS Concludes Oman Joint Venture to Build Middle East Protein Hub
summary: JBS completed its transaction with Oman Food Investment Holding Company to establish a joint venture in Oman, holding an 80% stake in the entity to expand its regional multi-protein presence.
why: JBS is the world's largest meat processing corporation, and expanding into the Gulf region targets growing food security and halal market demand.

impacts.name: JBS S.A.
impacts.why: Finalizing the 80% joint venture establishes JBS's distribution footprint in the Middle East.
